subject: alt-f
title: ALT.F.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in The New York Movement section (NYM-3), above the passage: 'a whole new community of musicians would solidify as a response to post-Ayler creativity, and the collective impact of this development would accelerate the vibrational voltage and spirit reshaping composite black creativity.' (C)ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information). The diagram poses what alternative-functionalism's crossing with multi-information looks like at the moment the post-Ayler New York School consolidates. The path from the subject to MT-INFO bends twice, at PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance) and at (C)LK-IMP (concept of linkage implications): ALT-F → PROJ-CONT → LK-IMP → MT-INFO (the crossing). On the first stretch hang SI (source initiation) and, by a *dashed* line, (C)ROTP (concept of responsibility-of-the-position); on the second, C-INFO (composite information); on the last, EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics), EXT-FT (extended functionalism) by a *dashed* line, (R)POST (real postulation) and STF (source transfer). In Braxton's legend a dotted line amplifies some aspect of the main concept it is connected to.
